name: n8n Starter
description:
Your own **n8n** instance for workflow automation.

- Unlimited workflows
- Daily backups

notices.text: Your owner password cannot be recovered by us. Keep it safe.

deployment.name: n8n-${USERNAME}
deployment.composeFile:
services:
  n8n:
    image: n8nio/n8n:1.80.0
    restart: unless-stopped
    expose:
      - "5678"
    environment:
      - N8N_HOST=n8n-${USERNAME}.${DOMAIN}
      - N8N_PROTOCOL=https
      - WEBHOOK_URL=https://n8n-${USERNAME}.${DOMAIN}/
      - N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY=${N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY}
      - GENERIC_TIMEZONE=${TIMEZONE}
    volumes:
      - n8n_data:/home/node/.n8n
volumes:
  n8n_data:
